spec.title: Standalone status
spec.description: 1 when the standalone extension can collect controller, backend, and storage status.

spec.title: Controller sessions
spec.description: Current standalone controller sessions by projection state.

spec.title: Active work
spec.description: Currently active and retrying backend windows, plus candidate builds in flight.

spec.title: Collation p95
spec.description: End-to-end successful candidate build duration at the 95th percentile.

spec.title: Collation stages
spec.description: Mean candidate time by non-overlapping stage, including state preparation, queue cleanup, message execution, account finalization, state-update construction, collated proofs, serialization, and final bookkeeping.

spec.title: Block throughput
spec.description: Successfully delivered candidates divided by the combined actual duration of recently completed local leader windows, excluding idle time. Uses a one-minute window and shows zero when no window completion is observed.

spec.title: Build problems
spec.description: Build results excluding success and not_ready. Not_ready is normal input waiting and is not mixed with failures.

spec.title: Candidate delivery p95
spec.description: Successful end-to-end candidate production duration through persistence, state commit, scheduling, and delivery.

spec.title: Outbound queue size p95
spec.description: 95th-percentile outbound queue size after producing a masterchain candidate.

spec.title: Produced candidate size p95
spec.description: 95th percentile of exact block and collated-data gauge samples for locally produced masterchain candidates. When multiple candidates are produced between Prometheus scrapes, only the latest one is visible.

spec.title: Latest produced block contents (exact)
spec.description: Exact contents of the latest masterchain candidate produced by this node. External messages are stacked with internal and tick-tock transactions; the separate total-transactions series is intentionally omitted. Each scraped value is exact; when multiple candidates are produced between Prometheus scrapes, only the latest one is visible.

spec.title: Schedule lateness p95
spec.description: Positive schedule lateness and pipeline build lead by event. Shardchain build_start excludes the first slot of each window; build_lead measures the head start of a pipelined build.

spec.title: Deadlines and pressure
spec.description: Rare decisions explaining empty blocks, waiting, and overload. All stacked series use events per second.

spec.title: Out-queue cleanup
spec.description: Cleanup stop reasons. Rising budget means the wall-clock budget is binding; block_full means the block limit is binding.

spec.title: Operator-actionable errors
spec.description: Producer alarms requiring investigation: short collated proofs, mandatory dequeue overflow, or a rebuild after exceeding the candidate size limit.

title: GTON Standalone Collator Metrics
description: Standalone collator operations dashboard aligned with the validator dashboard. MASTERCHAIN and SHARDCHAIN show collation metrics with fixed chain filters; controller status, collator storage, and node storage are shown separately.
